question.instructions: Which category best describes this customer inquiry?

criteria.billing: invoices, charges, refunds, subscription or payment problems
criteria.bug: something is broken, errors, crashes, unexpected behaviour in the product
criteria.question: how-to or informational question about using the product
criteria.feature_request: asks for new functionality or an improvement that does not exist yet
criteria.complaint: dissatisfied or angry about service, people or experience; not a bug report
criteria.spam: unsolicited marketing, scams, irrelevant or automated junk
